verdict: Paid leads are running cheap at $13.49 each, but calls and CRM tracking are the missing link.
diagnosis: Instagram lead ads delivered 298 leads at $13.49 average cost this period, well below legal industry norms, yet call volume stayed at 122.

signals.detail: Lead form ads are converting well below the projected $21 legal benchmark, suggesting strong ad-to-form alignment this period.

benchmark.label: BENCHMARK
benchmark.body: Law firm cost per lead on Meta is projected around $21 in 2026, up from $18.17 in 2025, with conversion rates near 10%. Your $13.49 is materially better than category norms.

seasonal.label: SEASONAL
seasonal.body: Debt-buyer lawsuits climbed sharply in 2026, with one state reporting collection filings up nearly 50%. Consumer demand for debt defense counsel is elevated heading into Q4.

competitor.label: COMPETITOR
competitor.subheader: FCRA and credit reporting cases spiking
competitor.body: FCRA litigation surged in 2026 as consumers challenge inaccurate credit reports. Competing consumer firms are leaning into credit reporting and debt harassment messaging to capture rising intent.

recommendations.title: Add call tracking to measure phone leads from ads
recommendations.detail: Only 122 call clicks were logged from Google this period. Consider a tracking number on ads and the site to see which channel actually drives calls.

recommendations.title: Test FCRA and debt-lawsuit angles in creative
recommendations.detail: Debt-buyer suits and credit report errors are trending. Worth testing ads that name these specific problems against your current Know Your Rights static.

recommendations.title: Turn 5-star reviews into ad creative
recommendations.detail: You added 5 new 5-star reviews and hold 770 total. Consider a review-quote static or video testimonial to lift trust and lower cost per lead further.
